title: Referable DR: ROC and operating points
draft_caption: ROC curves for referable DR (grade ≥ 2; score p2 + p3 + p4), one line per seed; dots mark each model's own operating point (predicted grade ≥ 2). On Messidor-2 the fine-tuned models operate at high specificity (about 0.97) and low sensitivity (about 0.3), well below what their ROC curves allow; a recalibrated threshold would be needed for screening.

title: Mild vs Normal across cohorts

title: Qwen training and validation loss by learning rate
sources: train_result.json of each run (Hugging Face trainer history); failed runs from collapse_vs_validation.csv
draft_caption: Training loss (A, running median of the trainer log) and validation loss after each epoch (B, log scale) of Qwen rank 16, CLAHE on, at three learning rates, three seeds each. Training stops when the validation loss has not improved for two evaluations, so runs differ in length, and the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss is kept (outlined dot). The failed run (dashed, lr 5e-4) never reaches the validation loss of any working run, as in F05A. The two large spikes (one lr 2e-4 and one lr 5e-4 seed) come after those runs' kept checkpoints. Mean kept validation loss by learning rate is in F05B.

title: RetiZero training curves
draft_caption: RetiZero (all weights trained) per epoch: training loss, validation loss and validation accuracy, three seeds per setting. Training stops after four epochs without a higher validation accuracy (at most 15 epochs) and the epoch with the highest validation accuracy is kept (outlined dot). Validation loss reaches its minimum by epoch 2 to 7 and then rises while training loss keeps falling.

title: Validation loss across the LoRA grid at lr 2e-4
sources: train_result.json of each run (final_01 and final_02 train folders)
draft_caption: Validation loss after each evaluation for every adapter in the lr 2e-4 grid (rank 8, 16, 32; alpha 16 or alpha = rank; CLAHE on and off; three seeds each; log scale). Every run reaches a validation loss in the same narrow range, consistent with the absence of any significant rank or alpha effect on the test set (F04). Later rises, the largest a rank-16 CLAHE-on seed at epoch 5, do not change the result: each run keeps its lowest-validation-loss checkpoint.

title: Study workflow
draft_caption: Study workflow. Exact duplicates were removed from APTOS 2019 before splitting. Each model was fine-tuned with its own preprocessing and training recipe, three seeds per setting, and its checkpoint was chosen on the validation set only. Both models were tested on the clean APTOS test split and on verified Messidor-2.

title: Qwen3-VL-8B with the LoRA adapter
sources: parameter_counts.json and safetensors headers; scoring records (prompt_tokens, forward_passes_per_image)
draft_caption: Qwen3-VL-8B as used here. The 4-bit base model is frozen; only the LoRA adapter (green) is trained, with next-token cross-entropy on the correct answer. At test time each of the five fixed answers is scored by its total log-likelihood, and the softmax over the five gives the grade probabilities.
